summary.zh: 查询交易、发票与支付状态
summary.en: Look up transactions, invoices, and payments

description.zh: 读取交易、订单与发票记录，查询结算和退款状态。适合核对收款或排查支付失败。首次连接在浏览器登录 PayPal 商家账号授权。
description.en: Read transactions, orders, and invoices, and check settlement and refund status. Useful for reconciling incoming payments or tracing a failed charge. Sign in with a PayPal business account on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 PayPal 商家账号并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to your PayPal business account and authorize
